decision.support_scope: Relative to original landmark-trained XGBoost, on controlled Validation and historically reused matched Test only; not superiority over DD-MDN or population validation

sampling_policy.candidate_policy: First real accepted frame at or after each0.4s tick from max(event observation start, observed Entry). Stop at observed event interval, not selected future outcome. Keep all rejections.
sampling_policy.history_policy: same0.6s displacement /0.4s longitudinal velocity difference; also verify original status/jump segmentation
sampling_policy.sample_policy: Chronological first two eligible origins per distance bin with >=0.8s within-bin gap; >=0.4s global gap. Maximum8/event. No future outcome used to rank/select.
sampling_policy.weighting: each event total1, training rescaled to row mean1; no positive/negative balancing
sampling_policy.gate: Train0–1m >=30 events, >=5 recordings and >=3 dates, with valid1s history; gate does not inspect Test performance
sampling_policy.selection: Lowest raw event-weighted mean BrierH1–H4 on new Exit-aware Validation; tie interval NLL then M0/M1/M2 order. Rounds and all hyperparameters fixed to original selected configs, no early-stop changes or search.
sampling_policy.calibration: same bounded log-time bias and scale likelihood fit, new Exit-aware Calibration dates only; always raw+calibrated Test reported
sampling_policy.evaluation: Original236 DD-matched and936landmark Test unchanged; separate new Exit-aware origins. Historical reusedTest, no independent new split.
sampling_policy.metrics: Same interval outcomes, event weighting, Train reverseKM IPCW and0..4s truncatedCRPS;400 recording clusters

caveats: Historically reusedTest, no new independent split
Improvements relative to old XGB not equivalent to superiority over DD-MDN
